instance-experimental-settings.optIntoFeaturesThatAre: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
instance-experimental-settings.experimentalFeaturesMayBreakAt: Experimental features may break at any time.
instance-experimental-settings.optionalProductFeaturesThatAre: Optional product features that are still being evaluated.
instance-experimental-settings.allowAgentsToPinBeta: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Myrmidon core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
instance-experimental-settings.showMyrmidonManagedBuiltIn: Show Myrmidon-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
instance-experimental-settings.durableWorkProductsBlogPosts: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
instance-experimental-settings.talkToEachAgentIn: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution.
instance-experimental-settings.connectAgentsToSlackGithub: Connect agents to Slack, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
instance-experimental-settings.addsAConferenceRoomOne: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
instance-experimental-settings.showTheDecisionsItemIn: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
instance-experimental-settings.useTheMyrmidon20: Use the Myrmidon 2.0 shell (rail, top bar, phone bottom bar, Commander entry) for the board. Pages and data stay unchanged; turning this off restores the 1.x shell.
instance-experimental-settings.showEnvironmentManagementInCompany: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
instance-experimental-settings.detectExternalUrlsInIssues: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
instance-experimental-settings.showExecutionWorkspaceControlsIn: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
instance-experimental-settings.treatAProjectThatHas: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
instance-experimental-settings.showTaskDetailControlsFor: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.
instance-experimental-settings.allowNewCodexAgentsTo: Allow new Codex agents to select the experimental Rust Myrmidon Runner, including authenticated runner ingress when a sandbox requires it. Onboarding continues to use legacy adapters. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.
instance-experimental-settings.instructAgentsToWriteUser: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
instance-experimental-settings.firstTaskProposeWithA: First task: propose with a plan document
instance-experimental-settings.whenTheUserSFirst: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
instance-experimental-settings.enableTheExperimentalSharedStatus: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
instance-experimental-settings.useTheSimplifiedMainSidebar: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
instance-experimental-settings.showSummarizerGeneratedStatusSlots: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
instance-experimental-settings.showInternalMyrmidonMaintainerTools: Show internal Myrmidon maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
instance-experimental-settings.hideTheLocalEnvironmentAnd: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
instance-experimental-settings.thisIsAnIsolatedGit: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
instance-experimental-settings.inPnpmDevOnceWait: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
instance-experimental-settings.showAServerSectionIn: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
instance-experimental-settings.addASmokeLabTab: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.
instance-experimental-settings.showAcceptedPlanDecompositionHistory: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
instance-experimental-settings.theseFeaturesAreGoingTo: These features are going to be removed.
instance-experimental-settings.restoresThePreviousTaskDetail: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
instance-experimental-settings.restoreTheGoalsItemIn: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.

instance-experimental-settings.toggleTaskPlanDecompositionPanel: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting
instance-experimental-settings.toggleClassicTaskInterfaceExperimental: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting
instance-experimental-settings.toggleGoalsSidebarLinkExperimental: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting

instance-experimental-settings.turningThisOffPreservesConversations: Turning this off preserves conversations and lets active runs finish, but prevents new messages.
instance-experimental-settings.turningThisOffHidesChat: Turning this off hides chat setup, channels, and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. GitHub and other tool connectors stay available.
instance-experimental-settings.the20ShellRuns: The 2.0 shell runs in parallel with 1.5: every page is shared, only the frame changes.
instance-experimental-settings.enablingStatusCardsAlsoEnables: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.
instance-experimental-settings.turningThisOffRestoresThe: Turning this off restores the legacy shell and navigation. Task and page data are unchanged.

instance-experimental-settings.switchingTakesEffectImmediatelyNo: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
instance-experimental-settings.theseFeaturesAreOptIn: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.
instance-experimental-settings.internalToolsForDevelopingTesting: Internal tools for developing, testing, and debugging Myrmidon.
